svg.text: EXAMPLE ONLY: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA, NOT A REAL EVALUATION
Feature 'income' has 8.3% missing values for group 'minority'
Positive outcome rate differs by 15% across groups
1. Collect more data for underrepresented group (age>65, n=12).
2. Investigate missing data pattern for bias in 'income' feature.
3. Review labelling process: 15% outcome disparity across groups.
Automated pre-training data-quality checks, categorised by severity and linked to affected groups.
Critical and error issues block training, warnings need review, info is advisory; the verdict is pass
only if no critical issues remain. EXAMPLE ONLY, synthetic demonstration data, not a real evaluation.
